## 🌟 Overview

Welcome to the official portfolio repository of **Nasrullah Hafiz (NSR.)**. This website showcases high-end design expertise spanning over half a decade in visual identity creation, press-ready packaging architecture, prepress print management, and typographic craftsmanship.

## 🚀 Key Features

- **🎨 Modern Dark Aesthetic & Micro-interactions**: Custom interactive glow cursor, smooth parallax navigation, and state-of-the-art responsive layout.
- **🌐 Bilingual Localization**: Seamless one-click switching between **English** and **বাংলা (Bengali)**.
- **📐 Interactive Print Calculator**: Real-time GSM, bleed, dieline tolerance, and CMYK prepress estimation tool.
- **💼 Comprehensive Project Showcase**: Categorized portfolio for Brand Identity, Typography (Bornomala, Font design), Packaging, and Editorial Print.
- **⚡ Ultra Fast & Production Ready**: Pre-bundled and optimized inside the [`dist`](dist/) folder for direct deployment.

---

## 📂 Project Structure

```text
├── assets/             # High-res portraits, project previews & brand assets
├── css/
│   └── style.css       # Complete modular design system & responsive styles
├── js/
│   ├── main.js         # Core interactivity, theme engine, and animations
│   ├── projects-data.js# Portfolio database and category filters
│   └── translations.js # Bilingual content dictionary (EN / BN)
├── dist/               # Production build ready for hosting/deployment
├── index.html          # Semantic HTML5 entry page
├── deploy.ps1          # One-click deployment script
└── README.md           # Project documentation
```

---

## 🛠️ Built With

- **HTML5**: Semantic tags, accessible landmarks, and rich SEO OpenGraph meta tags.
- **Modern CSS3**: CSS Grid, Flexbox, custom design tokens, backdrop filters, and CSS keyframe animations.
- **Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+)**: Zero bulky framework overhead for blistering load speeds.
- **Typography**: Google Fonts (*Hind Siliguri, Plus Jakarta Sans, Space Grotesk, JetBrains Mono*).

---

## 🚀 Deployment

The project is structured to deploy anywhere instantly:

### GitHub Pages:
1. Go to repository **Settings** > **Pages**.
2. Select Source: **Deploy from a branch** > Branch: **`main`** > Folder: **`/ (root)`** or **`/dist`**.
3. Save and your site will be live.

### Vercel / Netlify:
- Connect this GitHub repository.
- Publish Directory: Set to `.` (root) or `dist`.
